culture_principles.name: Public mission and customer-impact alignment
culture_principles.description: Salesforce fit should connect work to the company outcomes and users described in cited public sources.

culture_principles.name: Evidence-backed execution
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should show practical judgment, clear tradeoffs, ownership, and outcomes rather than generic enthusiasm.

culture_principles.name: Trust as the customer foundation
culture_principles.description: Public values language places trust first, which for a platform company means security, transparency, and reliability are part of the product rather than support work.

culture_principles.name: Learning velocity with new technology
culture_principles.description: Careers material frames AI fluency as an ongoing learning path, so candidates should show how they actually acquire and apply new tooling.

culture_principles.name: Values expressed through team behaviour
culture_principles.description: Public material ties values to collaborative, diverse teams, which makes how someone works with others a visible part of performance.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects decisions to the users, customers, products, or markets named in public company sources.
Uses concrete examples to show ownership, learning, and measurable improvement.
Connects a technical decision to customer trust, data handling, or platform reliability consequences.
Shows a concrete example of learning a new platform capability and applying it to a real business problem.
Describes enabling a customer or partner team to own a solution after handover.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic admiration for the company without a concrete role, customer, product, or business mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public lens usage should stay grounded in cited source signals and role-relevant evidence.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Reciting Salesforce values or 'Ohana' language without a behavioural example behind it.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Values language is public, but without behaviour it provides nothing to evaluate.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating Salesforce as one role family across sales, engineering, success, and ecosystem work.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public careers material describes distinct functions with different expectations.

interview_patterns.pattern: Use cited public source signals to test role-relevant judgment, ownership, communication, and impact.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official Salesforce hiring standard.
It contains source metadata and non-verbatim public-safe signals only.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
